data: Apple's fiscal 2025 ended September 27, 2025. From memory rather than a fresh look at the filing, it reported net sales of about $416.2 billion, up roughly 6% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Net income was about $112.0 billion, up roughly 20% from $93.7 billion, or about $7.46 per diluted share. Total assets were about $359.2 billion at fiscal year-end, compared with $364.98 billion a year earlier. Please check these figures against Apple's Form 10-K for fiscal 2025 before relying on them.
